description: The label above a field or a group (DESIGN.md, Field): TsuyaType.control in TsuyaColors.textMuted. With optional, a space and the optional label follow at normal weight, in the same run of text, so a screen reader reads "Email Optional" together rather than two separate texts. A required control marks no visual change here (it is in semantics only, carried by the control itself, not this label).

constructors.description: A label reading text, with the optional marker appended when optional.

params.name: optional
params.description: Appends the optional marker after a single space, at normal weight.
